import.leiras: Copy an Obsidian vault into a new Manifold workspace. You see exactly what will be copied before anything happens.
import.forras_erintetlen: Your original vault is not modified. Manifold only reads it and copies the files into a new folder.
import.setup.leiras: Copy an existing vault into a new Manifold workspace. Your original vault stays exactly as it is.
import.cel_seged: Manifold creates this folder and copies your files into it. It must not exist yet, or it must be empty.
import.ut_hiba: Enter the full path of a folder. It starts with / or ~.
import.valaszto_hiba: The folder chooser could not be opened. Type the path instead.
import.opcio.obsidian_leiras: Copies the .obsidian folder, so your Obsidian settings carry over.
import.opcio.kuka_leiras: Also copies the .trash folder. Off by default.
import.elonezet_tolt_leiras: Manifold is reading the folders. Nothing is copied yet.
import.jovahagyas: Nothing is copied until you press Start import. Files are copied unchanged, and your original vault is not touched.
import.folytatas_leiras: An earlier import of these folders stopped before it finished. Files already copied are kept, and resuming continues where it stopped.
import.mar_kesz_leiras: Nothing more will be copied. You can undo the import if you want to start over.
import.atiras.nincs: Files are copied unchanged. Links, properties and attachments are not rewritten.
import.atiras.van: Some files are adjusted while they are copied.
import.kihagyott.leiras: These items are left out of the copy. They stay in your original vault.
import.lista_csonkitva: The list is shortened. The complete plan is kept with the import records.
import.kihagy.specialis: Special file, not a regular file
import.utkozes.kis_nagy: Names differ only by letter case
import.utkozes.normalizalas: Names differ only in how accented letters are stored
import.utkozes.cel_elter: A different file with this name already exists in the destination
import.utkozes.sema_elter: A different schema file already exists and is kept
import.linkek.valtozatlan: Links stay exactly as written. Nothing is rewritten, so they keep working the same way.
import.beallitasok.nincs: No Obsidian settings were found to carry over.
import.nematvett.tul_nagy: The file is too large to read
import.nematvett.hibas_json: The file is damaged and could not be read
import.nematvett.ervenytelen: The value is not valid in Manifold
import.nematvett.masolva_nem_olvasott: Copied, but Manifold does not read it
import.nematvett.sema_hibas: The schema file is not valid
import.plugin.figyelmeztetes: Some plugins are not supported. Their files are copied, but they do not run in Manifold.
import.plugin.kozossegi_leiras: Manifold never runs community plugins. Their folders are copied unchanged together with your settings.
import.akadaly.ismeretlen: The import cannot start with these folders.
import.akadaly.forras_nem_mappa: The source is not a folder. Choose the folder that contains your Obsidian vault.
import.akadaly.forras_nem_olvashato: Manifold cannot read the source folder. Check its permissions.
import.akadaly.cel_a_forrasban: The destination is inside the source vault. Choose a folder outside it.
import.akadaly.forras_a_celban: The source vault is inside the destination. Choose a destination outside it.
import.akadaly.cel_nem_ures: The destination folder is not empty. Choose a new or empty folder.
import.akadaly.cel_munkater: The destination is already a Manifold workspace.
import.akadaly.nev_utkozes: Some names would collide in the destination because they differ only by letter case or accents.
import.akadaly.fajl_utkozes: The destination already has a different file with the same name as a file in the vault.
import.akadaly.keves_hely: There is not enough free space for the copy.
import.akadaly.nincs_install: Manifold has no place to keep the import records. Repair or reinstall Manifold.
import.akadaly.import_fut: An import of these folders is already running.
import.akadaly.hordozhato_elrendezes: Imports are not available in a portable setup.
import.akadaly.nem_mappa: The destination exists and is not a folder.
import.akadaly.szulo_hianyzik: The folder that should contain the destination does not exist.
import.akadaly.nem_irhato: Manifold cannot write to the destination. Check its permissions.
import.akadaly.kodfaban: The destination is inside Manifold's own program files. Choose another folder.
import.akadaly.telepitesben: The destination is inside Manifold's data folder. Choose another folder.
import.akadaly.kodfat_tartalmaz: The destination contains Manifold's own program files. Choose another folder.
import.akadaly.telepitest_tartalmaz: The destination contains Manifold's data folder. Choose another folder.
import.akadaly.munkateren_belul: The destination is inside another workspace. Choose a folder outside it.
import.akadaly.munkater_symlink: The destination workspace data is a shortcut (symbolic link), which Manifold does not follow.
import.akadaly.workspace_toml_hibas: The destination already holds workspace settings that cannot be read.
import.akadaly.workspace_id_hibas: The destination already holds a workspace with an invalid identity.
import.akadaly.workspace_ujabb: The destination holds a workspace made by a newer version of Manifold.
import.akadaly.munkateret_tartalmaz: The destination contains another workspace. Choose a different folder.
import.akadaly.masik_telepites_fut: Another Manifold is already using the destination.
import.akadaly.halozati_kotet: The destination is on a network drive. Choose a folder on this computer.
import.akadaly.v2_nincs_konfig: This folder has no config/os.toml file, so it is not a Manifold-OS folder.
import.akadaly.v2_toml_hibas: The config/os.toml file in this folder cannot be read.
import.akadaly.sema_cel_kivul: The schema file would be written outside the workspace.
import.figy.forras_munkater: The source already contains Manifold workspace data. It is copied like any other folder.
import.figy.keves_hely: Free space is tight. The copy may not fit.
import.figy.kihagyott_elemek: Some items are left out of the copy.
import.figy.nem_tamogatott_pluginok: Some Obsidian plugins are not supported.
import.figy.nagy_vault: This is a large vault. The copy can take a while.
import.figy.nem_apfs: This disk has no fast-copy support, so some safety features are reduced in the new workspace.
import.figy.szinkron_mappa: The destination is in a synced folder. Sync services can interfere with a large copy.
import.figy.allapot_mas_koteten: The workspace data will be kept on a different disk than the notes.
import.figy.utkozes_kihagyva: Conflicting settings are skipped and not overwritten.
import.hiba.megmarad: Files copied so far are kept. You can review and resume the import, or undo it.
import.javitas.tilos: Change the folders and preview again.
import.javitas.terv_valtozott: The folders changed after the preview. Preview the import again, then start it.
import.javitas.fut: An import of these folders is already running. Follow it in the import history.
import.javitas.utkozes: Choose an empty destination folder or move the conflicting file, then preview again.
import.javitas.munkater_hasznalatban: Open a different workspace, then undo the import.
import.javitas.visszafordit_utkozes: Nothing was changed. Check the file named above, then try again.
import.javitas.forras_valtozik: Close the app that is changing the vault, then resume the import.
import.javitas.masolas_hiba: Files copied so far are kept. Review and resume the import, or undo it.
import.javitas.nincs: Refresh the import history and try again.
import.javitas.ervenytelen_keres: Check the folder paths and try again.
import.javitas.beallitas_hibas: A setting from Obsidian could not be applied. Try again, or import without the Obsidian settings.
import.javitas.munkater_csere: Reopen the workspace and try again.
import.javitas.fejleszto_mod: Turn on Developer mode in Settings > About to use this import.
import.javitas.kapcsolat: Manifold could not be reached. Check that it is running, then try again.
import.fut.leiras: You can hide this panel. The import keeps running and appears in the import history. If it is interrupted, you can resume it.
import.kesz.forras_valtozott: These source files changed while they were being copied. The copy has the version read at that moment.
import.kesz.kovetkezo: Open the new folder as a workspace to start using it. If you want to start over, you can undo this import. Files you change after the import stay where they are.
import.kesz.ismetles: Everything was already imported. Nothing new was copied.
import.lista.ures_leiras: Imports you run appear here with their status and records.
import.lista.ures_v2: Imports from Manifold v2 appear here.
import.visszaford.leiras: The imported files and the new workspace data move to the Trash. Files you changed after the import, and files that were not part of it, stay where they are.
import.visszaford.v2_leiras: The settings this import changed are restored to what they were. If one of those files was edited after the import, nothing is changed and Manifold tells you which one.
import.visszaford.folyamatban_leiras: Moving the imported files to the Trash. This can take a moment.
import.visszaford.megtartva_cim: These files stayed where they are:
import.v2.leiras: Take your own conventions from an earlier Manifold-OS folder into the settings of this workspace. The folder is only read.
import.v2.gomb: Import settings from a Manifold-OS folder
import.v2.forras_erintetlen: The Manifold-OS folder is only read. It is never changed.
import.v2.jovahagyas: Nothing is written until you press Apply import. Settings your workspace already sets are never overwritten.
import.v2.nincs_valtozas: The workspace already matches. There is nothing to import.
import.v2.sema.ir: will be created in the workspace
import.v2.sema.utkozes: a different schema file exists and is kept
import.v2.utkozes_leiras: Your workspace already sets these to another value, so they stay as they are.
import.v2.ujrainditas_elore: Applying this import needs a restart of Manifold to take effect.
import.v2.ujrainditas: Restart Manifold for the imported settings to take effect.
import.megszakit.leiras: Copying stops after the file that is being copied. Files already copied are kept, and you can resume the import later or undo it.
import.megszakitva.megmarad: The files copied so far are kept. Review and resume the import to finish it, or undo it. Nothing else was changed.
import.javitas.nem_fut: This import is not running any more. Refresh the import history to see what happened.
import.javitas.megszakitva: Review and resume the import, or undo it.
{kesz} / {osszes} fájl másolva a megszak: {kesz} of {osszes} files were copied before the import stopped.
